decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program has its own page, extends the firm's core clinical offer, and is backed by reimbursed demand, so results likely meet aspirations while the expanding firm has slack to carry it.

The custom-furniture carpentry workshop builds on the sheltered workshop's production know-how and has its own page, so with growth-related slack there is little shortfall to trigger search, though its market revenue is less certain.

Outpatient sociotherapy fits the firm's mental health services and is reimbursed, but it is only mentioned on the website, which suggests modest visibility, while there is still no clear shortfall to prompt dropping it.
Senior living counseling is featured on the home page, is close to the core eldercare business, and is cheap to run, which signals satisfactory performance and strong commitment.
The sheltered workshop's retail shop is only mentioned and faces retail market risk, but the expanding firm's slack and the shop's link to the workshop mission favor keeping it for now.
